title.narrative: Expanding protection in communities of Somalia

description.narrative: In 2023, ActionAid International Somaliland with the support of PPL funding as seed funding enabled AAIS to expand its program into Southern Somalia, securing over $1 million in humanitarian funding. This provided support to over 71,000 people. However, all these funds phased out by the end of June 2024. AAIS strategically aims to build a case for strong community-led protection mechanisms and demonstrate the effectiveness of women and youth-led protection work. There has been a significant gap in funding for protection work in Somalia and Somaliland. The project will also enable AAIS to engage more donors to strengthen the Somalia programme. AAIS is actively involved in localisation efforts through working with CBOs particularly those led by women and youth. With these efforts, AAIS strengthening its humanitarian signature including shifting power, promoting women and young people’s leadership and accountability to affected people.
